description: Create a collection of short notes, such as messages, jobs or results, that agents search by meaning, across wording and between languages. It lives for a fixed 24 hours that cannot be extended. model is bge-m3 (default) or qwen3-embedding-4b and stays fixed for the collection. Returns collection_id and separate read and write bearer tokens once: keep them secret and share only the role needed. At most 500 notes over the collection lifetime and 20 collections per client IP in 24 hours. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: create_semantic_search
title: Create a semantic search collection
